data.name: Back Alley Darts
data.detailed_description:
Back Alley Darts is a crowd-play darts experience designed for interactive, social gameplay. Compete for the highest score, hit the bullseye, and climb to the top of the leaderboard.

Earn points as you play to unlock new content, including custom darts, unique flights, and a variety of back alley environments and dartboards. The more you play, the more you unlock.

Built with streaming in mind, Back Alley Darts allows Twitch streamers to share gameplay live with their audience, enabling real-time interaction through chat and video. It’s a fusion of competitive darts, customization, and social streaming, with a growing collection of content to keep the experience fresh.

Key Features:
• Competitive leaderboard-based gameplay
• Unlockable darts, flights, and environments
• Custom back alleys and dartboards
• Designed for live, interactive streaming

Requirements & Compatibility:
• Requires a Twitch connection and Velora to play
• Available on Windows and macOS

data.short_description: Back Alley Darts is a crowd-play game designed Back Alley Darts Game experience. The aim of the game is try and get a bulls eye or the hiest points going and be the top of the leaderboard. The more points you get the better it is as you will unlock stuff in the game to be able to use in the game

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD Phenom II X4 945
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTS 450 or AMD Radeon HD 5770
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Required for online features (Twitch/Velora chat).
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.13 (High Sierra) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Apple M1/M2/M3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable GPU (Intel HD 4000 or better)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Standard macOS compatible audio
  • Additional Notes: Supports both Intel and Apple Silicon natively. Required for online features (Twitch/Velora chat).
